Features: About 0.12 seconds per refresh. Only black and white; dots simulate gray. Fastest response, with some ghosting. Called A2 in the screen driver.

功能: 约 0.45 秒刷完。有 16 级灰阶，不闪黑，文字和图片细腻。（GLD16）
Features: About 0.45 seconds per refresh. 16 gray levels without a black flash, for smoother text and images. GLD16.

功能: 约 0.9 秒刷完。画面会先闪一下黑再显示，能把残影彻底清掉。（GC16）

功能: 上一张画面没有完全擦干净留下的淡淡痕迹，墨水屏刷新越快越容易出现。

功能: 系统里负责把画面转换成墨水屏驱动信号并送上屏的那段程序（硬件合成器 HWC）。
Features: The system component that converts images into e-ink drive signals and sends them to the screen: the hardware composer, or HWC.

功能: 墨控提供的显示后端：把原厂由 CPU 逐像素做的图像处理换到 GPU 上并行完成。波形动画、触摸响应加速、消除锁屏细线都依赖它。
Features: InkControl moves pixel-by-pixel image processing from the CPU to parallel GPU computation. Waveform animations, faster touch response, and lock-screen line removal depend on it.

功能: 动画中途停下来显示的一张静止画面。墨水屏不能像普通屏幕那样每秒播放几十帧，所以墨控用 1–3 张中间画面拼出动画，每张都要完整刷新一次。
Features: A still image shown partway through an animation. E-ink cannot display dozens of frames per second, so InkControl uses 1–3 intermediate images, each requiring a complete refresh.

功能: 方形展开、关键帧擦除：依次显示几张中间画面实现。不需要 GPU 显示后端，但每多一张就多一次刷新。
Features: Square reveal and keyframe wipe show a sequence of intermediate images. They need no GPU backend, but each extra image adds a refresh.

功能: 墨迹晕开、网点长大、扫描线、百叶窗：在屏幕驱动层让不同位置的像素错开一点时间开始刷新，一次刷新之内完成，所以又快又顺。需要 GPU 显示后端。
Features: Ink spread, growing dots, scanlines, and blinds stagger when different pixels begin refreshing. The effect completes within a single refresh and requires the GPU display backend.

功能: 墨水屏驱动一次给整屏送电压的周期，本机约 11.7 毫秒（每秒 85.8 次）。一次极速刷新约需 10 帧。
Features: One cycle of screen-wide drive voltages: about 11.7 ms on this device, or 85.8 cycles per second. One Extreme refresh takes about 10 scan frames.

功能: 墨水屏里的墨水颗粒天冷时移动变慢，同一种刷新要多花几倍时间：24°C 以上极速刷新约 10 帧，3°C 以下要 35 帧。墨控读取电池温度，自动按当前温度取刷完所需的时间。
Features: E-ink particles move more slowly when cold. An Extreme refresh needs about 10 scans above 24°C and 35 below 3°C. InkControl uses battery temperature to choose the required hold time.

功能: 把灰色转换成黑白小点的方法。点排得越均匀，远看越像平滑的灰；排得不好会出现条纹或雪花闪烁。
Features: Converting gray into small black-and-white dots. An even pattern looks smoother from a distance; a poor pattern can create stripes or flicker.

功能: 利用上一帧的黑白结果，让亮度只有小变化的像素保持原状态，减少静止区域闪点。可能增加拖尾。独立开关仅适用于 Bayer、蓝噪声和固定阈值；原厂误差扩散自带历史处理，不由此开关控制。
Features: Use the previous black-and-white result to keep pixels stable when brightness changes only slightly. It reduces static-area flicker but may increase trailing. The separate switch supports Bayer, blue noise, and fixed threshold; stock error diffusion has its own history processing.

功能: 关机再开机（不是只锁屏）。替换系统文件的功能要在开机过程中才能装载。

功能: 翻页动画由墨控自己的 GPU 波形层实现，需要同时开启 GPU 显示后端：整屏刷新按选定的风格逐带揭示，与分模式算法、波形动画同时生效，开关与参数实时生效不用重启。触发范围由「目标阅读器」名单决定：只有名单里的应用在前台时才播放。GPU 显示后端关闭时翻页动画不生效。
Features: The page-turn animation is implemented by InkControl's own GPU waveform layer and requires the GPU display backend: a full-screen refresh is revealed band by band in the chosen style, together with per-mode algorithms and waveform animations, and switches and parameters apply live without a restart. The trigger range is set by the "Target readers" list: it plays only while a listed app is in the foreground. With the GPU display backend off the page-turn animation has no effect.

功能: 翻页是一次整帧瞬间替换，画面直接跳变。
Features: A page turn replaces the whole frame at once and the picture jumps.

功能: 新一页按方向或分块逐步展开，看得出翻页过程。
Features: The new page unfolds gradually by direction or by bands, so the turn is visible.

功能: 不额外停用其它功能，但同一应用内的整屏刷新（含滚动与弹窗）也会一起播放。
Features: No other feature is disabled, but full-screen refreshes inside the same app (including scrolling and dialogs) play it too.

功能: 横向或纵向整片展开，以及斜向、反斜向、环绕、中心四种分块展开。选完下次翻页生效。
Features: Horizontal or vertical whole-sheet reveal, plus four banded reveals: diagonal, anti-diagonal, ring and center. Takes effect on the next page turn.

功能: 新画面从一侧向另一侧整片推开。
Features: The new picture pushes across as one sheet from one side to the other.

功能: 新画面从上往下或从下往上整片推开。
Features: The new picture pushes as one sheet from top to bottom or bottom to top.

功能: 沿对角线把画面切成若干条依次揭示。
Features: The picture is cut into strips along the diagonal and revealed in turn.

功能: 与斜向相反的对角线方向。
从四周向中间或从中间向四周逐圈揭示。
Features: Revealed ring by ring from the edges inward or from the center outward.

功能: 以画面中心为起点向两侧展开。
Features: Unfolds to both sides starting from the center of the picture.

功能: 阶段越少越快、越接近瞬间切换；越多展开越明显，一次翻页也更慢。
Features: Fewer phases are faster and closer to an instant switch; more phases make the reveal more visible and each page turn slower.

功能: 几乎一闪而过，适合不想拖慢翻页。
Features: Almost a flash; for when you do not want page turns slowed.

功能: 原模块默认值，速度与观感比较平衡。
Features: The original module's default; a fair balance of speed and look.

功能: 最慢，仅建议对照效果用。
Features: Slowest; recommended only for comparing effects.
How many bands the new picture is cut into

功能: 块数越多，展开的颗粒越细、边界越不明显；分块类风格会自动调整到 4 的倍数。
Features: More bands give a finer reveal with less visible edges; banded styles adjust to a multiple of 4 automatically.

功能: 原模块默认，块感最明显。
Features: The original module's default; the most blocky look.
Finest; close to a continuous reveal.

功能: 翻页方向默认跟手势走：左滑或点右半屏＝翻下一页，右滑或点左半屏＝翻上一页。开启这一项会把自动判断的结果反过来。
Features: By default the direction follows the gesture: swipe left or tap the right half for the next page, swipe right or tap the left half for the previous page. Turning this on reverses the automatic result.

功能: 音量键翻页按习惯定方向
Features: Volume-key page turns use the conventional direction

功能: 音量键没有「点在哪一边」的信息，方向只能按习惯给：音量+＝上一页、音量-＝下一页。关闭后按键翻页沿用上一次点击或滑动的方向——比如刚在右侧点过，按音量+ 时动画也从右往左，和习惯相反。
Features: Volume keys carry no "which side was tapped" information, so the direction follows convention: Volume+ is previous page, Volume- is next page. When off, key page turns reuse the direction of the last tap or swipe; for example, after a tap on the right, Volume+ also animates right to left, the opposite of convention.

功能: 只对选中的阅读器生效
Features: Only applies to the selected readers

功能: 只有名单里的应用才触发翻页动画；默认不内置任何应用，自己选。融合模式下这是唯一的触发条件：不在名单里的应用（含墨控自己）不会播放，名单留空则完全不触发。
Features: Only listed apps trigger the page-turn animation; none is built in by default, so choose your own. This is the only trigger condition: apps not on the list (including InkControl itself) never play it, and an empty list means it never triggers.

功能: 选「无」或关闭此场景，都恢复原厂的瞬间切换。
Features: Choosing "None" or turning this scene off both restore the stock instant switch.

功能: 黑色光带扫过一屏，过程柔和，去残影效果相同。形状、方向与快慢分别在“全刷扫过风格”“全刷扫过方向”“全刷扫过速度”里设置。
Features: A black band sweeps across the screen; the process is gentle and ghost removal is the same. Shape, direction and pace are set separately under "Full-refresh sweep style", "Full-refresh sweep direction" and "Full-refresh sweep speed".

功能: 全刷扫过的光带是什么形状
Features: The shape of the full-refresh sweep band

功能: 按翻页动画那套分块展开的思路，让整屏刷新按不同形状依次开始：横向一条带、纵向一条带、斜向分块、反斜向分块、从中心向外的一圈圈，或者从中心平滑扩开。
Features: Following the banded-reveal idea of the page-turn animation, the full-screen refresh starts in different shapes: a horizontal band, a vertical band, diagonal bands, anti-diagonal bands, rings spreading from the center, or a smooth expansion from the center.

功能: 只改变“谁先开始刷新”，波形与去残影效果不变；斜向、环绕、中心展开不使用“全刷扫过方向”。
Features: Only "which part starts refreshing first" changes; the waveform and ghost removal stay the same. Diagonal, ring and center reveals do not use "Full-refresh sweep direction".

功能: 光带左右扫过，最接近原厂整屏刷新。
Features: The band sweeps left-right; closest to the stock full-screen refresh.

功能: 从左上角向右下角斜着铺开，像翻页动画的斜向分块。
Features: Spreads diagonally from the top-left corner to the bottom-right, like the page-turn animation's diagonal bands.

功能: 从右上角向左下角斜着铺开。
Features: Spreads diagonally from the top-right corner to the bottom-left.

功能: 从屏幕中心向外一圈圈扩散，分成 12 圈。
Features: Spreads outward from the screen center in 12 rings.

功能: 从屏幕中心均匀扩开，没有分圈痕迹。
Features: Expands evenly from the screen center with no visible rings.

功能: 不开启时为 12 帧。全刷扫过有自己的“全刷扫过速度”，不受这一项影响。
Features: 12 frames when off. The full-refresh sweep has its own "Full-refresh sweep speed" and is not affected by this item.

功能: 动画擦除方向：从哪一侧开始
Features: Animation wipe direction: which side it starts from

功能: 关键帧擦除、扫描线和百叶窗从屏幕的哪一侧开始；只影响这三类动画，全刷扫过另有自己的方向与风格。
Features: Which side of the screen keyframe wipe, scanlines and blinds start from; only these three animations are affected, and the full-refresh sweep has its own direction and style.

功能: 全刷扫过从哪一侧开始
Features: Which side the full-refresh sweep starts from

功能: 系统做“清晰全刷”去残影时，那道黑色光带从屏幕的哪一侧开始扫。
Features: When the system performs a "Clear full refresh" to remove ghosting, which side of the screen the black band starts sweeping from.

功能: 只在“全刷扫过”启用时生效，与“动画擦除方向”互不影响；不开启时横向从左向右、纵向从上向下。
Features: Only effective while "Full-refresh sweep" is enabled and independent of "Animation wipe direction"; when off, horizontal runs left to right and vertical top to bottom.

功能: 沿用原厂习惯：从左向右扫过。
Features: Follows the stock habit: sweeps left to right.

功能: 全刷扫过这道光带走多快
Features: How fast the full-refresh sweep band travels

功能: 光带扫完整屏时，屏幕上不同位置的像素错开多久开始刷新。帧数越少，光带越宽、走得越快，1 帧几乎等于整屏同时刷新（也就是原厂的整屏闪黑）；帧数越多，光带越窄、过程越明显，但整段会稍微变长。
Features: How far apart in time pixels at different positions start refreshing as the band crosses the screen. Fewer frames make the band wider and faster; 1 frame is almost a simultaneous full-screen refresh (the stock full-screen black flash). More frames make the band narrower and the process more visible, but the whole pass gets slightly longer.

功能: 只在“全刷扫过”启用时生效，与上面的“波形动画速度”互不影响；不开启时跟随“波形动画速度”。整段仍是原厂一次清晰全刷，去残影效果不变。
Features: Only effective while "Full-refresh sweep" is enabled and independent of "Waveform animation speed" above; when off it follows "Waveform animation speed". The whole pass is still one stock Clear full refresh with the same ghost removal.

功能: 几乎整屏同时刷新，和原厂全刷一样快，只留一点扫过的痕迹。
Features: Almost a simultaneous full-screen refresh, as fast as the stock full refresh, leaving only a trace of the sweep.
A very wide band that sweeps quickly.

功能: 光带宽度与速度都比较均衡。
Features: Band width and speed are fairly balanced.

功能: 与之前跟随波形动画速度时相同。
Features: Same as before, when it followed the waveform animation speed.

功能: 光带最窄，过程最清楚，整段略长。
Features: The narrowest band and the clearest process; the pass is slightly longer.

功能: 横版构图，横转手机阅读：大号时间加方框，右侧倒数日框，右下电池与通知，左下格言。
Features: Landscape composition for reading with the phone turned sideways: large boxed time, countdown box on the right, battery and notifications at bottom right, motto at bottom left.

功能: 编辑排版-横 旋转 180°，适合手机反向横转阅读。
Features: Editorial landscape rotated 180°, for reading with the phone turned the other way.

功能: 在锁屏卡片上显示当前天气、温度和图标。原厂锁屏的天气来自桌面时钟/天气小组件，桌面上没放那个小组件时它就没有数据。选择「天气App」后，墨控直接读取系统预装的天气软件（墨迹天气）已经下载的天气，不需要桌面小组件，仍然不额外联网。
Features: Show the current weather, temperature and icon on the lock-screen card. Stock lock-screen weather comes from the launcher clock/weather widget and has no data when that widget is not on the launcher. With "Weather app" selected, InkControl reads the weather already downloaded by the preinstalled weather app (Moji Weather) directly; no launcher widget is needed and no extra network access is made.

功能: 「天气App」用的是天气软件最后一次下载的结果；开机后没打开过天气软件、长期不打开它、或把它冻结，都可能取不到，此时自动退回原厂数据。
Features: Weather app uses the weather app's last downloaded result; if the app has not been opened since boot, has not been opened for a long time, or is frozen, data may be unavailable and the stock source is used automatically.

功能: 沿用原厂锁屏天气，数据来自桌面时钟/天气小组件；没有放小组件时通常取不到。
Features: Keep the stock lock-screen weather, sourced from the launcher clock/weather widget; usually unavailable when the widget is not placed.

功能: 直接读取系统预装的天气软件（墨迹天气）已下载的数据，不需要桌面小组件。
Features: Read the data already downloaded by the preinstalled weather app (Moji Weather) directly; no launcher widget is needed.
Show a notification strip at the bottom of the lock screen

功能: 锁屏倒数日下方那一块位置只有一处，本页是「显示通知」这个总开关。开启后在来源里选：系统通知、微信未读，或者「不显示」把这块留空。关闭则整块都不画：编辑排版的「通知 N 条」框、横版的右下通知框、瑞士与液态玻璃右下角的通知数、像素样式的通知数和通知一格都会消失，腾出的位置不会再摆空框。
Features: There is only one area below the lock-screen countdown, and this page is the "Show notifications" master switch. When on, choose a source: system notifications, WeChat unread, or "Do not show" to leave the area empty. When off the whole area is not drawn: the "N notifications" box in Editorial, the bottom-right notification box in landscape, the notification count at the bottom right of Swiss and Liquid glass, and the notification count and cell in Pixel all disappear, and no empty frame is left in their place.

功能: 只影响显示，通知照常统计；关掉再打开马上恢复，不用等新的通知。想在那块位置显示无线、蓝牙等开关情况，请开启「显示设备状态」——两者互斥，开一个会自动关掉另一个。
Features: Only display is affected; notifications are still counted, and turning it back on restores the display at once without waiting for a new notification. To show wireless, Bluetooth and similar states in that area, enable "Show device status"; the two are mutually exclusive, and enabling one turns the other off automatically.

功能: 开关保持开启，但锁屏底部不画通知条；不用为了留空先去关总开关。
Features: The switch stays on but no notification strip is drawn at the bottom of the lock screen; no need to turn the master switch off just to leave it empty.

功能: 锁屏底部改显示设备开关状态
Features: Show device switch states at the bottom of the lock screen instead

功能: 同一块位置（倒数日下方、上滑解锁提示上方）改画设备状态：无线网络、蓝牙、声音模式、飞行模式是否开启。要显示哪几项，到「显示信息修改」里逐个开关；关掉的项不再占位，其余各项自动均分宽度。本页选的是画成什么样：跟随样式、图标版还是文字版。
Features: The same area (below the countdown, above the swipe-up hint) shows device status instead: whether wireless, Bluetooth, sound mode and airplane mode are on. Choose which items to show under "Edit displayed items"; hidden items take no space and the rest share the width evenly. This page chooses the look: follow style, icons, or text.

功能: 只读显示，不会改动无线、蓝牙、飞行模式或铃声音量。与「显示通知」互斥：开启本项会自动关闭「显示通知」，反之亦然；两项都关时那块位置留空。像素样式是英文标牌（ON / OFF），固定用图标版；瑞士网格本身就是纯文字排版，选「跟随样式」时用文字版。
Features: Read-only display; it never changes wireless, Bluetooth, airplane mode or ringer volume. Mutually exclusive with "Show notifications": enabling this turns "Show notifications" off automatically and vice versa; with both off the area stays empty. The Pixel style uses English signs (ON / OFF) and always uses icons; Swiss grid is a pure text layout and uses text when "Follow style" is selected.

功能: 编辑排版、横版用图标版，瑞士网格用文字版，与各样式原本的观感一致。
Features: Editorial and landscape use icons and Swiss grid uses text, matching each style's original look.

功能: 左侧一个线描图标、右侧「开 / 关 / 静音 / 有声」。
Features: A line icon on the left and "On / Off / Silent / Sound" on the right.

功能: 「无线|开」这类类型加竖线加状态，两边同字号同基线，没有图标。
Features: A type, a vertical bar and a state, such as "Wireless|On", in the same size on the same baseline, without icons.

功能: 选择设备状态里显示哪几项
Features: Choose which device-status items to show

功能: 锁屏底部那块位置宽度固定，项越多每格越窄。这里逐项决定画不画：无线网络、蓝牙、声音模式、飞行模式。关掉的项直接不占位，剩下的自动均分宽度；四项全关时那块位置留空。
Features: That area at the bottom of the lock screen has a fixed width, so more items mean narrower cells. Decide here item by item: wireless, Bluetooth, sound mode, airplane mode. Hidden items take no space and the rest share the width evenly; with all four off the area stays empty.

功能: 四项开关只影响显示，不会改变无线、蓝牙、飞行模式或铃声音量本身。四个都是默认显示：新装或升级后不用先来这里设置；关掉某一项才需要记住。画成图标还是文字在上一页「显示设备状态」里选。
Features: The four switches only affect display and never change wireless, Bluetooth, airplane mode or ringer volume themselves. All four are shown by default, so nothing needs setting here after an install or upgrade; only hiding an item needs remembering. Icons or text is chosen on the previous page, "Show device status".

功能: 设备状态里是否显示无线网络
关掉后锁屏设备状态条里不再出现无线这一格，其余各项自动补位。默认显示；只影响这一格，不会关闭无线网络。
Features: When off, the wireless cell no longer appears in the lock-screen device-status strip and the other items fill in. Shown by default; only this cell is affected and wireless is not turned off.

功能: 设备状态里是否显示蓝牙
关掉后锁屏设备状态条里不再出现蓝牙这一格。默认显示；只影响这一格，不会关闭蓝牙。
Features: When off, the Bluetooth cell no longer appears in the lock-screen device-status strip. Shown by default; only this cell is affected and Bluetooth is not turned off.

功能: 设备状态里是否显示声音模式
Features: Whether device status shows sound mode

功能: 关掉后锁屏设备状态条里不再出现声音这一格（其余样式里是「静音 / 有声」，像素样式里是喇叭的 ON / OFF）。默认显示；只读铃声音量模式，不会改音量。
Features: When off, the sound cell no longer appears in the lock-screen device-status strip ("Silent / Sound" in other styles, a speaker ON / OFF in Pixel). Shown by default; it only reads the ringer mode and never changes the volume.

功能: 设备状态里是否显示飞行模式
Features: Whether device status shows airplane mode

功能: 关掉后锁屏设备状态条里不再出现飞行这一格。默认显示；只读飞行模式状态，不会改变它。
Features: When off, the airplane cell no longer appears in the lock-screen device-status strip. Shown by default; it only reads the airplane-mode state and never changes it.

功能: 一个开关管显示，本页直接编辑事项
Features: One switch controls display; edit the events right on this page

功能: 打开后在锁屏上显示事项倒数日：最多三个，每组一个事项和日期，多个按目标日先后排列。下方就是事项编辑器——事项名可留空；日期为空该组停用。
Features: When on, event countdowns are shown on the lock screen: up to three, each with a name and a date, ordered by target date. The event editor is below; the name may be empty, and a group with no date is disabled.

功能: 关闭后锁屏不再显示倒数日，已填的事项和日期仍保留，再打开即恢复。
Features: When off, the lock screen no longer shows countdowns; the names and dates you entered are kept and return when it is turned on again.

功能: 倒数日事项的数据存储位置
Features: Where countdown event data is stored

功能: 最多三个倒数日，每组有独立的「农历日期」和「显示」开关：开启农历后按农历年/月/日计算（如选 2027-01-01 即 2027 年春节）；关闭显示可暂时隐藏该组而不删除。编辑入口已并入上一页「锁屏倒数日」，这里是它的数据保存位置，旧配置继续有效。
Features: Up to three countdowns, each with its own "Lunar date" and "Show" switches: with lunar on, the date is read as a lunar year/month/day (2027-01-01 means Lunar New Year 2027); turning Show off hides a group temporarily without deleting it. Editing has moved to the previous page, "Lock-screen countdown"; this is where its data is saved, and old configurations remain valid.

功能: 每组一个事项和日期，在「锁屏倒数日」页下方编辑。
Features: One name and date per group, edited at the bottom of the "Lock-screen countdown" page.

功能: 给原厂桌面换一套完整的外观。下面的图标、壁纸、组件可以分别开关；图标位置和桌面布局保持不变。
Features: Give the stock launcher a complete new look. The icons, wallpaper and widgets below can be switched separately; icon positions and launcher layout stay unchanged.

功能: 换掉系统正在用的字体
Features: Replace the font the system is using

功能: 填字体所在目录（默认是海信主题字体目录，也可以填 TF 卡上的文件夹，或点「选择目录」从文件管理器挑），目录里的 TTF/OTF 会逐个列出来，可用搜索框按名字过滤；墨控按文件头识别，文件不用改扩展名。点某个字体右侧的「应用」，字体文件会以独立路径写进 /data/fonts、把 HmctFont.ttf 与 persist.sys.font* 指过去，并微扰 font_scale 让所有界面立即重建——照海信主题商店做法复刻的全局热切换，状态栏、锁屏、桌面与正在运行的应用立刻一起换字，不用重启。目录读不到时，可用「从文件选择」直接挑一个字体文件。
Features: Enter the folder that holds your fonts (the default is the Hisense theme font folder; a folder on the TF card works too, or tap "Choose folder" to pick one from the file manager). The TTF/OTF files in it are listed one by one and can be filtered by name in the search box; InkControl identifies them by file header, so extensions need not be changed. Tap "Apply" next to a font and the file is written to /data/fonts under its own path, HmctFont.ttf and persist.sys.font* are pointed at it, and font_scale is nudged so every screen rebuilds immediately. This reproduces the Hisense theme store's global hot switch: status bar, lock screen, launcher and running apps change together without a restart. If the folder cannot be read, use "Choose from file" to pick a font file directly.

功能: 把系统设置存成快照，需要时写回去
Features: Save system settings as a snapshot and write them back when needed

功能: 只备份系统设置本身：息屏时长、锁屏时长、各声道音量、默认输入法、字体名、护眼与游戏模式、显示模式、开发者选项开关。快照存在 /data/adb/inkcontrol/backup 里（清除应用数据也不会丢），恢复出厂或换回原样时逐条写回。
Features: Only the system settings themselves are backed up: screen-off timeout, lock timeout, per-stream volumes, default input method, font name, eye-care and game modes, display mode and the developer-options switch. Snapshots are stored in /data/adb/inkcontrol/backup (they survive clearing app data) and are written back entry by entry after a factory reset or when you want the old state back.

功能: 不备份应用自己的数据、不备份锁屏密码、不碰应用安装信息。恢复不会覆盖系统文件，也不会让「设置」打不开——它是逐条写设置项，失败的那条跳过、其它的照写，恢复前还会先给当前状态拍一张，写坏了能退回去。少数临时状态项（下次闹钟、是否有更新）和无障碍服务清单会跳过，那几项由系统和墨控自己维护。
Features: App data, the lock-screen password and app installation records are not backed up. Restoring never overwrites system files and cannot make "Settings" unopenable: entries are written one by one, a failed entry is skipped while the others continue, and the current state is snapshotted first so a bad restore can be undone. A few transient entries (next alarm, update available) and the accessibility-service list are skipped; the system and InkControl maintain those themselves.

功能: 冻结安全输入服务后，密码框仍能正常输入
Features: Password fields still accept input after the secure input service is frozen

功能: 原厂在密码输入框里一律强制切到「安全输入服务」，却不检查这个输入法是否还在。冻结它之后，系统服务找不到对应组件就会抛错，设置的密码界面直接崩溃：隐藏应用进不去、想临时删掉密码也做不到；应用锁的解锁界面被系统强制结束后，反而直接放行应用，等于没锁。开启后墨控把原厂自己留的总开关置 0，密码框改用你当前在用的输入法；关闭开关时还原原来的值。
Features: Stock forces every password field to switch to the "secure input service" without checking that this input method still exists. Once it is frozen, the system service cannot find the component and throws, and the Settings password screen crashes: hidden apps cannot be entered and the password cannot even be removed temporarily, and when the app-lock unlock screen is force-closed by the system the app is let through, as if never locked. When on, InkControl sets the stock master flag to 0 so password fields use your current input method; turning the switch off restores the original value.

功能: 冻结安全输入服务后：隐藏应用密码框打不开，加了应用锁的应用不输密码就能进。
Features: After freezing the secure input service: the hidden-apps password field cannot open, and app-locked apps open without a password.

功能: 开启后：密码框正常弹出，隐藏应用与应用锁都按密码校验。
Features: When on: the password field appears normally, and hidden apps and app lock both verify the password.

功能: 密码会经过你当前选中的输入法，不再走原厂安全键盘；在意这一点就不要冻结安全输入服务，保持原厂行为。切换开关立即生效，不用重启。只改这一个系统设置项，不动输入法本身，也不解冻任何应用。
Features: Passwords pass through your currently selected input method instead of the stock secure keyboard; if that matters to you, do not freeze the secure input service and keep stock behavior. The switch applies immediately without a restart. Only this one system setting is changed; the input method itself is untouched and no app is unfrozen.
